description:

2027 Clinical Pharmacology Internship Overview
Envision spending your summer working with energetic colleagues and inspirational leaders, all while gaining world-class experience in one of the most dynamic organizations in the pharmaceutical industry. This is a reality for AbbVie Interns.
AbbVie’s Clinical Pharmacology (ClinPharm) organization provides critical scientific support for all phases of pharmaceutical research and development in all divisions of the business. ClinPharm leads the design, execution, and interpretation of all clinical pharmacology Phase 1 studies, and exposure-clinical response modeling and simulation to optimize dose selection and trial design. The team also integrates data from multiple sources including preclinical and clinical pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, dosing compliance/adherence, effective and toxic exposures, financial metrics, and overall cost/benefit. Another key responsibility of the team is to present the data to regulatory authorities world-wide and authors more than half of the clinical summary documents for global regulatory submissions.
Internship projects could vary and are dependent on therapeutic area needs. Current therapeutic areas supported include Immunology, Oncology, Neurology, and Specialty assets.
Key project responsibilities include:
Analysis of literature and in-house proprietary data
Dose- and Exposure- Safety & Efficacy Endpoint Analysis
Database analyses
Development of mathematical models (e.g. PK/PD, Population PK, etc.)
Conducting simulations using mathematical models
Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD)
Clinical study design
Presentation to the broader team at the conclusion of the assignment
Publication of authorized analyses
Minimum Qualifications
Currently enrolled in university, pursuing a PharmD or PhD in Pharmacokinetics, Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Clinical Pharmacology, or other related field
Must be returning to university for at least one semester following the internship
Preferred Qualifications
Expected graduation date between December 2027 – June 2028
Experience analyzing scientific literature and data, including database and dose- or exposure-response (safety and efficacy) analyses
Familiarity with developing and running mathematical models and simulations (e.g., PK/PD, Population PK), ideally in a Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) context
Understanding of clinical study design

Promote a culture of engineering excellence, safety, quality, reliability, collaboration, accountability and proactive risk management.

AbbVie Analytical Research & Development (Analytical R&D) is a global analytical scientific organization responsible for all CMC analytical activities related to the development of AbbVie's pharmaceutical products.  Our scope includes AbbVie's diverse pipeline of innovative small molecule medicines and spans from the selection of Discovery candidate molecules to Late Stage Clinical.  We are building a world-class team of scientists and leaders who will drive the advancement of industry-leading analytical capabilities and make meaningful contributions to advance AbbVie's pipeline of innovative medicines.  Careers in AbbVie Analytical R&D provide unique opportunities to work with global and cross-functional teams to drive exceptional science and innovative product development strategies.  We are looking for diverse candidates with strong scientific experience to join the AbbVie Analytical R&D team and can offer exciting and rewarding career opportunities for these candidates.
Position Description:
This Senior Scientist – Solid State Characterization position will be in a technical specialty group - Physical Analytical Chemistry (PAC) withing Analytical R&D.  The PAC group is a global team of experienced and innovative scientists which utilize a diverse set of physical analytical tools to advance CMC development programs by providing insights and driving the understanding of materials, processes, and products.  Additionally, the group contributes to development and justification of control strategies and authors relevant sections of regulatory submissions across all development phases.
We are looking for a subject matter expert in X-ray and electron diffraction for crystallographic and solid-form characterization of drug substances (DS) and drug products (DP), from early form discovery through regulatory filing. The role focuses on single crystal X-ray diffraction (SCXRD), Powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD), electron diffraction (3D ED/MicroED), Rietveld refinement, quantitative phase analysis (QPA), and phase-appropriate polymorph quantitation methods both in drug substance and drug products. The scientist will work closely with Molecular Profiling Drug Development, Process Chemistry, Formulation, Process Engineering, Analytical, Operations, Quality Assurance and CMC-Regulatory.
Key Responsibilities:
Support new product development with advanced methods development and validations, technical transfer packages, and generation of technical data in support regulatory requirements.
Serve as technical SME in X-ray and electron diffraction for crystallographic and solid-form characterization of DS and DP; Responsible for PXRD method development for DS and DP, validation/technical transfer packages, and generation of technical data in support regulatory requirements
Serve as the PXRD expert for supporting solid form screening, identification, crystallinity, and stability studies; perform indexing, Pawley/Le Bail fitting, Rietveld refinement, and structure determination from powder data.
Perform quantitative phase analysis: Quantify polymorphic and amorphous content in DS and DP using Rietveld, whole-pattern, and multivariate approaches, addressing low drug load, excipient interference, preferred orientation, and micro absorption.
Apply advanced diffraction such as VT/VH-XRPD, in situ, synchrotron, and PDF analysis to study phase transformations and poorly crystalline/amorphous materials.
Apply SCXRD and 3D ED/MicroED structure determination, including absolute configuration and crystal packing of APIs, salts, cocrystals, hydrates, and solvates; generate calculated powder patterns and CIF reports.
Conduct orthogonal solid-state characterization including X-ray diffraction, thermal analysis, moisture sorption, microscopy, spectroscopy as applicable for solid form, impurity and stability studies
Support solid form control strategies per ICH Q6A, author Module 3 sections and health authority responses, and ensure GMP and data integrity compliance.
Highly autonomous and productive in performing laboratory work, method development and troubleshoot; processing, interpreting, and visualizing data to facilitate project team decisions
Represent PAC on CMC teams, lead form-change investigations, mentor scientists, and implement new diffraction technologies.
Build strong relationships with peers and cross functionally with partners outside of team to enable higher performance.
Routinely demonstrate scientific initiative and creativity in research or development activities and maintain a high level of productivity in the lab.
Understand and adhere to corporate standards regarding code of conduct, safety, appropriate handling of materials, controlled drug and radioactive compounds, and GxP compliance, where applicable.
Qualifications:
Bachelors, Masters, or Ph.D. in Chemistry, Material Science, Physics, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related field typically with minimum 10 (BS), 8 (MS), or 0 – 2 (Ph.D.) years related industry experience.
Strong technical background in solid state characterization, excellent analytical problem-solving, communication, presentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Capable of independently developing and troubleshoot analytical methods.
Extensive hands-on PXRD experience, including indexing, Rietveld refinement, QPA, and polymorph and amorphous quantitation.
Track record of developing and validating PXRD methods for DS and DP in a GMP environment, with knowledge of ICH Q2(R2), Q6A, Q14, and USP .
Expertise in small molecule SCXRD structure solution and refinement, including disorder modeling and absolute structure; and knowledge of 3D ED/MicroED approaches.
Proficiency with tools such as Olex2, SHELX, CrysAlisPro, TOPAS, Diffrac Eva and DQuant, GSAS-II, HighScore, Mercury, and the CSD.
Hands-on experience with DSC, TGA, hot-stage and polarized light microscopy, DVS, and strong data analysis and interpretation skills.
Experience with Raman/FTIR/NIR, solid-state NMR, SEM, SAXS, micro-CT, and crystal structure prediction, and particle characterization is preferred.
Experience with AI/ML and data science for automation of phase identification and Rietveld/QPA workflows, chemometrics, and Python or R scripting is preferred.
Experience with biophysical characterization tools of nanoDSC, DLS, SEC-MALS, CD, AUC, nanoDSF in peptide, LNP and biologic materials, formulations and process characterization is preferred.
Strong pharmaceutical industry experience in solid state characterization is preferred
Ability to coordinate activities and work simultaneously on multiple projects, in a global, fast-paced setting where priorities may change quickly.

Knowledge of instrument set-up, troubleshooting, management and maintenance.

title: Sr Principal Engineer, Clean Utilities (North Chicago)
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Position Summary
AbbVie is seeking a Senior Principal Engineer, Clean Utilities to serve as a global technical authority for the design, delivery and performance of clean utility systems supporting our worldwide manufacturing network. You will lead Clean Utilities engineering for complex brownfield expansions and greenfield facilities, set technical direction, develop global standard designs, and guide projects from feasibility through commissioning, qualification and handover. Working with Global Engineering, Strategic Investments, manufacturing sites, Quality, EHS, Validation/CQV and external engineering partners, you will deliver technically robust, compliant and business-aligned solutions that help improve capacity, reliability and efficiency in a regulated, patient-focused environment.
Global Engineering Context
Global Engineering provides engineering leadership, technical governance, standards development and project execution support across AbbVie’s global manufacturing network and strategic investment portfolio.
The organization supports greenfield manufacturing facilities, new technology platform deployments, brownfield expansions, modernization programs, debottlenecking initiatives, lifecycle asset replacement, infrastructure upgrades and capacity expansion investments.
Global Engineering roles are expected to promote common standards, transfer lessons learned across regions and sites, and enable consistent engineering delivery across strategic capital investments.
Key Responsibilities
Global Technical Execution Support
Lead Clean Utilities workstreams for complex brownfield and greenfield capital projects from feasibility and front-end planning through BOD design stage of the project. Provide technical support during detailed design, construction, commissioning, qualification, startup, and handover.
Develop, maintain and deploy standard designs and philophies associated with generation and distribution of Clean Utilities including water reclaim,  Potable Water, Lab Water, Purified Water, WFI, Pure Steam and Process Gas systems
Partner with Key stakeholders including operators, system owners, quality, and third party design firms.
Provide risk based technical input for system commissioning and qualification in support of URS’s, Risk Assessments, Functional Requirements, Verification protocols, PQ’s.
Provide technical leadership for clean utility operation and maintenance troubleshooting, including system excursion root cause analysis, CAPAs and remediation.
Independently verify design calculations and assumptions including hydraulic calculations, diversifications, and system modeling.
Lead multidisciplinary design reviews, constructability reviews, code evaluations, vendor technical evaluations, and technical bid analyses. Resolve advanced non-compliant or constrained existing conditions using risk-based engineering judgment.
Ensure engineering deliverables comply with AbbVie standards, approved project requirements, applicable GxP expectations, EHS requirements, and relevant codes and industry practices. Document assumptions, rationale, calculations, risks, decisions, and recommended mitigations.
Advise leadership on complex technical decisions, alternatives, risks, cost and schedule impacts, reliability implications, sustainability opportunities, and operational readiness. Escalate issues with clear evidence and actionable recommendations.
Coordinate scope, interfaces, deliverables, technical resources, schedules, and discipline budgets with project managers, site engineering, operations, Quality, Validation/CQV, EHS, MS&T, architects, other engineering disciplines, EPCM firms, vendors, and OEMs.
Analyze existing system performance and lead improvements that increase capacity, reliability, maintainability, energy efficiency, environmental performance, and total lifecycle value. Apply data operating data, commissioning, and maintenance systems to identify and sustain improvements.
Mentor engineers, provide technical review and coaching, develop training, and foster engineering excellence, accountability, collaboration, and proactive risk management.
Represent the Clean Utilities discipline in governance forums, project reviews, investigations, change controls, CAPAs, and regulatory or inspection-readiness activities as required.
Decision-Making and Organizational Impact
Independently establishes technical approaches and priorities for assigned complex projects and programs within approved governance and business objectives.
Provides expert contributions that materially influence project outcomes, facility performance, compliance, capital deployment, production continuity, and lifecycle operating cost.
Exercises judgment where requirements are incomplete, competing priorities exist, or solutions require integration of technical, quality, safety, operational, financial, and schedule considerations.
Influences cross-functional teams and external partners without relying on direct reporting authority; decisions may affect multiple functions, sites, or technology platforms
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science or a relevant technical discipline required; advanced degree preferred where relevant.
Typically 8+ to 14+ years of Clean Utility engineering within the BioPharmaceutical Industry, manufacturing, capital project, technical operations or regulated manufacturing experience.
Experience in system design, operation, and troubleshooting of both Generation and Distribution systems
Demonstrated technical capability in reliability, safety, compliance, energy, infrastructure and project delivery support as related to clean utilities.
Experience supporting pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, medical device, API, peptides, biologics, sterile or similarly regulated manufacturing environments preferred.
Demonstrated ability to work across global functions, manufacturing sites, project teams, suppliers, vendors and external engineering partners.
Strong communication, risk management, technical judgment, stakeholder engagement and structured problem-solving skills.
Core Capabilities
Deep Clean Utility expertise with strong understanding of system integration, controls, commissioning, reliability, maintainability, and facility operations.
Ability to convert complex technical information into concise, business-aligned recommendations for project teams, site leaders, and senior stakeholders.
Strong technical writing, design review, quality checking, facilitation, and stakeholder-influence skills.
Proven ability to manage multiple complex priorities, operate effectively in a matrixed global organization, and collaborate across cultures, functions, sites, and external organizations.
Commitment to integrity, safety, quality, inclusion, continuous improvement, and delivery of products that serve patients.
Working Relationships
This role works globally with Strategic Investments, Global Engineering disciplines, manufacturing sites, quality, validation / CQV, EHS, operations, MS&T, supply chain, finance, external engineering firms, technology vendors and equipment suppliers. The role is expected to operate across multiple projects, manufacturing sites and technology platforms, supporting both brownfield and greenfield investments.
Working Conditions
Work is performed in office, project/field site, laboratory, manufacturing, utility, and construction environments. The role may require use of appropriate personal protective equipment, access to mechanical spaces, field walkdowns, and domestic or international travel. Specific physical, travel, and work-schedule requirements should be confirmed for the hiring location and assignment.

Lead HVAC and building mechanical engineering for complex brownfield and greenfield capital projects, from feasibility and front-end planning through Basis of Design, with continued support during detailed design, construction, commissioning, qualification, startup, and handover.
Define and approve HVAC design philosophies, user and system requirements, Basis of Design documents, airflow and pressure-cascade strategies, temperature and humidity control, zoning and segregation concepts, equipment selections, and sequences of operation.
Provide technical leadership for air-handling, exhaust, heat-recovery, chilled-water, hot-water, dehumidification, filtration, cleanroom, laboratory, containment, and building automation systems, including process and plant utility interfaces.
Perform or independently verify load calculations, psychrometric analyses, duct and piping sizing, pressure-drop calculations, control strategies, energy models, capacity and redundancy assessments, and lifecycle evaluations.
Lead multidisciplinary design and constructability reviews, code evaluations, vendor technical evaluations, and bid analyses. Resolve non-compliant or constrained existing conditions using risk-based engineering judgment.
Ensure deliverables comply with AbbVie standards, project requirements, GxP expectations, EHS requirements, and applicable codes and industry practices. Document assumptions, rationale, calculations, risks, decisions, and mitigations.

Provides expert contributions that materially influence project outcomes, facility performance, compliance, capital deployment, production continuity, and lifecycle operating cost.

Influences cross-functional teams and external partners without direct reporting authority; decisions may affect multiple functions, sites, or technology platforms.

Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.
Professional Engineer license or progress toward licensure.
Experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing environments, including cleanrooms, aseptic or biologics facilities, laboratories, containment, commissioning, qualification, and GxP documentation.
Experience applying ASHRAE 55, 62.1, 90.1, and 170 where relevant; ISO 14644 cleanroom concepts; LEED or equivalent frameworks; and risk-based design methods.
Experience with BMS and controls, sequences of operation, fault detection and diagnostics, energy metering, Revit/BIM coordination, CFD or advanced airflow analysis, and lifecycle cost analysis.
Certification such as PE, CEM, LEED AP, or commissioning-related credentials.

Deep HVAC and mechanical engineering expertise, with strong understanding of system integration, controls, commissioning, reliability, maintainability, and facility operations.
Ability to convert complex technical information into concise, business-aligned recommendations for project teams, site leaders, and senior stakeholders.
Strong technical writing, design review, quality checking, facilitation, and stakeholder-influence skills.
Proven ability to manage multiple complex priorities, work effectively in a matrixed global organization, and collaborate across cultures, functions, sites, and external organizations.
Commitment to integrity, safety, quality, inclusion, continuous improvement, and delivering products that serve patients.

Work is performed in office, project, laboratory, manufacturing, utility, and construction environments. The Community You Will Join:
Airbnb's Online Data organization runs the stores behind every booking, every message, and every payment. Storage Foundation owns the engines underneath those stores. We build and operate Airbnb's source of truth databases for the company's online OLTP traffic, and we own the control plane that provisions, upgrades, and heals them. This is engine work, not fleet administration. When our engines are slow, unavailable, or wrong, so is the product.
As Senior Engineering Manager you will lead engineers across multiple teams and you will manage managers. You will own the engine strategy, the reliability commitment that every service above you depends on, and the growth of the people who do the work. Your leverage comes from the managers and technical leads on your teams, the bar you hold in design and incident reviews, and the trust you build with the teams who stake their product on us.
The Difference You Will Make:
Set the technical direction for Airbnb's online storage engines
You will set a multi-year technical vision for the engines and the control plane beneath every transactional and key value store at Airbnb, and you will make the calls that follow from it. That includes where we invest in our own engine expertise, where we buy instead of build, how we evaluate alternative engines against real production traffic, and which capabilities have to exist before a workload can safely land on us. You will also make the cost of these systems measurable and attributable, so that investment decisions rest on evidence. You will make these calls alongside senior technical leaders across Online Data and the broader Infrastructure organization.
Make reliability the ground truth of the platform
The services built on your engines commit to availability targets that only hold if the engine underneath them is better than they are. You will own that engine level commitment and the error budgets that feed every product surface above it. You will drive fault isolation so that one tenant cannot degrade everyone else, prove regional failover with scheduled production drills, and treat capacity headroom as a reliability decision. You will own incidents in your area personally, and you will turn each one into a structural fix.
Make routine work disappear
Every ticket is a product team waiting on us and an engineer pulled off platform work. You will push your teams to build API first, so that provisioning, schema changes, grants, and quotas can be driven by an engineer, a tool, or an agent without a human in the loop. You will use AI where it takes real work off your teams.
Build and grow the team
You will coach engineering managers and senior technical leads, and grow the depth of database expertise inside Airbnb. That means taking a forward view of talent needs, building a succession pipeline, hiring senior engineers who can own a complex open source codebase, and creating the conditions where people do the most technically ambitious work of their careers. Experience leading teams that build and operate Tier 0 distributed systems, with accountability for availability targets, on call health, and incident response at a company where downtime is visible to customers

ABOUT THIS ROLE
As a Senior Technical Program Manager focused on Business Risk, you'll serve as the strategic risk advisor to one of Audible's business organizations, partnering with its senior leaders to understand and manage the risks they face across security, fraud, content piracy, data protection, brand, and operational domains. Audible's businesses depend on a broad network of external partners, vendors, platforms, and technology, and increasingly on AI-enabled operations. Each relationship and each system is a place where unauthorized access, fraud, data exposure, or operational failure can become financial loss or harm to the Audible brand.
You will own Audible's business risk program for the organization you support end to end. You'll assess its business processes, vendor and partner relationships, and technology stack; drive remediation programs to completion with Audible InfoSec, Amazon Security, and business teams; run the recurring risk review and risk acceptance process; and own risk reporting to business and Audible leadership. Rather than building new programs, you'll use Audible's and Amazon's established risk management programs and paved path solutions, including security, fraud defense, piracy prevention, and data protection, and help the business adopt them in a way that fits how it works. Your understanding of the organization's strategy and roadmap will let you position risk management as an enabler, so the business can scale, enter new markets, and launch new initiatives safely.
ABOUT YOU
You thrive at the intersection of risk advisory and business enablement. You see risk not as a blocker but as a lens that helps a business grow safely and move faster. You are comfortable starting where the problem is not yet defined: you can take an open question such as "how exposed are we, and where?", frame the program, set its goals and success metrics, and drive it to delivery with limited guidance. You build trusted relationships with senior business leaders, translate technical risk into business language, and influence teams that do not report to you, including security, engineering, legal, and external partners. You make thoughtful trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term risk reduction, and you know how and when to escalate without damaging relationships. Your security background lets you speak credibly with security teams and understand the technical detail behind a risk. Our platform orchestrates petabyte-to-exabyte scale distributed compute and query engines alongside modern GenAI inference and agent runtimes.
We are seeking an exceptional Senior Engineering Manager to establish, build, and lead the Data and AI Platform Security & Architecture organization. In this role, you will champion a shift in platform security: moving away from reactive audits and ever-expanding rulebooks toward convergence, approved architectural implementations, and continuous automated verification. You will spearhead our "secure by construction" strategy, ensuring every control plane, data plane, and AI service adheres to rigorous security invariants from day one while maintaining high developer velocity.
Minimum qualifications: 15+ years of software engineering experience with a strong emphasis on large-scale distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or data/AI platforms.
8+ years of engineering management experience leading and growing technical teams; experience managing staff/principal engineers or managers is highly preferred.
Demonstrated expertise in Platform & Infrastructure Security: In-depth knowledge of modern Identity and Access Management (IAM), OAuth/OIDC, mTLS, SPIFFE/workload identity, secrets management, network segmentation, and zero-trust architectures.
Large-Scale Cloud & Container Systems: Strong technical grasp of Kubernetes (container security, pod identity, runtime isolation), cloud-native service frameworks, and microservices design.
Governance & Standards: Track record of driving engineering teams through enterprise security programs, risk assessments, threat modeling, and regulatory/compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC2, PCI-DSS, ISO).
Leadership & Communication: Exceptional written, verbal, and executive-level communication skills; ability to distill complex architectural trade-offs into actionable technical strategy.
Education: BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred qualifications: Hands-on architectural experience with distributed compute engines (Spark, Flink, Ray), distributed query systems (Trino, Druid, Iceberg), or modern ML/LLM serving platforms (vLLM, Ray Serve).
Familiarity with the unique security threat landscape of Generative AI, LLM proxies, autonomous agents (sandboxing, tool calling, MCP), and data privacy controls for AI training and inference.
Experience building automated policy-as-code engines, continuous conformance testing harnesses, or automated compliance telemetry platforms.
Active participation in open-source security or data communities, or track record of public technical presentations and whitepapers.

title: Senior Engineering Manager, People Engineering - G&A Solutions Engineering
description:
Want to build some of the largest, most consequential enterprise systems in the world? Join Apple's Information Systems & Technology (IS&T) organization — the engine behind everything Apple does for its customers and the people who build for them. IS&T supports 2.5 billion active Apple devices and processes billions of secure transactions, keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly. We take on global complexity and immense scale so that every interaction feels effortless.
G&A Solutions Engineering (GSE) is IS&T's dedicated technology partner for Apple's general and administrative functions — including people, finance, facilities, legal, and security. The team builds and delivers integrated technology solutions that keep these functions running efficiently and securely at global scale. GSE also works closely with business teams to develop custom tools that improve productivity and bring greater automation and consistency to G&A operations across Apple.
You'd join People Engineering, a small, global team that ships quickly while building for the long term. We craft durable, reliable systems and high-quality, user-centric experiences — bringing AI and system interoperability together to make every interaction intuitive, seamless, and genuinely useful.
We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the engineers building tools that support Apple's people worldwide. Our teams use web and native technologies (HTML5, PHP, CSS, JavaScript, MySQL, Swift, Symfony, and Drupal) to create applications that let Apple's employees focus on their roles and feel supported in their daily work.
In this role, you'll lead a team of engineers at several levels, including senior engineers and the technical and project leads who run day-to-day delivery, and you'll be accountable for everything the team delivers across its part of the People Engineering application portfolio. You'll also have dotted-line responsibility for other engineering managers in People Engineering, supporting and developing them as leaders. You'll hire and grow the team, set your area's engineering roadmap with business partners and People Engineering and IS&T leadership, and manage your area's headcount, budget, and priorities. You'll partner with People Engineering's architect and senior technical leaders on technical direction, and you'll stay close enough to the systems to make sound calls on architecture, risk, and trade-offs as they come up.
Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
12+ years of professional software engineering experience
7+ years as the people manager accountable for a software engineering team or teams, including engineers at a range of levels and the technical or project leads who run delivery
Experience developing managers, or technical leads into managers, through direct or dotted-line relationships
Proven record of hiring and developing engineers and engineering leaders, including performance management and career development
Experience owning delivery for a portfolio of production applications, including roadmap planning, prioritization, and operational accountability
Experience managing budgets and vendor or contractor relationships
Strong technical background in web application development with PHP and a modern framework (e.g., Symfony or Drupal), SQL databases, and RESTful APIs, enough to lead design reviews for your team's work and take a full part in architecture reviews, judging risk, cost, and trade-offs
Experience with secure software development practices (e.g., OWASP) and with operating applications that handle sensitive employee data
Experience with modern engineering practices, including automated testing, code review, CI/CD, Git, and container-based deployment
Proven ability to turn business goals into technical plans with business partners and senior leaders, and to explain trade-offs and risk clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including presenting plans, risks, and investment cases to executives
Preferred qualifications: Experience managing managers or leading multiple teams
Hands-on experience with Drupal and Symfony, including custom module development
Experience with Laravel
Experience leading teams that bring AI into the development lifecycle or into products, including LLM- or agent-based features and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations
Experience with identity and authentication integration (OAuth, OIDC, SAML, single sign-on) across multiple applications
Experience leading teams that build systems for a global user base across multiple regions and languages
Experience with data integration and Extract-Transform-Load (ETL) processes across enterprise systems
Experience leading teams distributed across locations and time zones

Experience working with design and research partners on accessible, user-centered products
Experience building internal tools or enterprise systems in a large organization

title: Senior Graphics Software Engineer, Vision Products Software
description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something.
Apple Vision Pro is a revolutionary spatial computer that seamlessly blends digital content with your physical space. It will allow us to do the things we love in ways never before possible — all while staying connected to the people around us.
The Vision Products Group (VPG) is looking for a Senior Graphics Software Engineer to help us push the limits of the next generation of interactive experiences on our platform. This team is working with some of Apple’s most advanced technologies including spatial computing, augmented reality, ARKit and Metal, to create ground-breaking new products. As a member of our creative organization, you will have the uniquely rewarding opportunity to craft future products that will delight and inspire millions of people every single day.
As a Senior Graphics Software Engineer, you’ll work with the newest technologies to bring Apple Vision Pro Environments to life. Environments give people an immersive space to work, watch, and play. People spend hours immersed under the auroras of Thórsmörk or sitting on the beach in Bora Bora, so every detail has to look convincingly real and every environment has to run efficiently to preserve battery life and keep the apps customers use running smoothly.
You’ll develop the system-level frameworks and real-time rendering techniques that make these places believable, from physically based materials to dynamic image-based lighting. You’ll write high-performance shaders, create RealityKit-based systems to drive effects, and profile each technique to analyze its GPU cost. You’ll use agentic workflows to iterate faster on development and optimization.
You’ll work closely with designers and technical artists across Apple and VPG, building the tools and pipelines that enable pre-visualization, optimization, and fine-tuning. You’ll partner with the teams that own the rendering engine and system-level frameworks to implement solutions and debug problems that cross the software stack. You work quickly and smartly to help determine the viability of new ideas and technologies. You bring a keen understanding of GPUs and lower-level programming. You have the ambition and curiosity to improve, innovate, and explore to bring surprise and delight to Apple customers.
Minimum qualifications: 7+ years of professional experience in real-time graphics or rendering engine development
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
Experience shipping high-quality GPU shaders and significant rendering features end to end
Proficiency in C++ and shader programming languages (Metal Shading Language, GLSL, or HLSL)
Proficient in mathematics for 3D real-time applications
Solid understanding of color science, human visual perception, texture sampling, compression, filtering, and of GPU memory management and frame pacing
Experience debugging complex rendering issues across multiple layers of the software stack
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to drive alignment across multiple partner teams
Preferred qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Graphics, or related field
Experience architecting and leading teams to build complex rendering systems
Understanding of Apple GPU architecture (tile-based deferred rendering)
Experience writing optimized code using profiling tools, assembly, SIMD, etc.
Experience reading and optimizing GPU intermediate representation formats
Experience using agentic iteration for rendering optimization

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Matching, Apple Ads
description:
At Apple, we focus deeply on our customers’ experience. Apple Ads brings this same approach to advertising, helping people find exactly what they’re looking for and helping advertisers grow their businesses! Our technology powers ads and sponsorships across Apple Services, including the App Store, Apple News, and MLS Season Pass.
Everything we do is designed for trust, connection, and impact: We respect user privacy, integrate advertising thoughtfully into the experience, and deliver value for advertisers of all sizes—from small app developers to big, global brands. Because when advertising is done right, it benefits everyone!
You'll have the opportunity to develop models that improve our platform across the board, write production code to generate recommendations, work closely with business partners to help drive the development of new products as well as perform large scale and complex experiments to understand their effects. You'll drive strategic outcomes through substantial innovation in multiple fields by leading the development and application of advanced techniques and algorithms to improve our ad network.
You've, or will develop a deep understanding of the ad network behavior, and will work with product management and business leadership to prioritize an innovation roadmap across multiple technical domains. You'll lead the conception, development, and delivery of state of the art capabilities that differentiate our products and are core to our business. You should have experience developing and implementing machine learning algorithms, ideally within the ads space. You'll have an excellent understanding of scalable architectures and thrive working in Agile environments. The ability to be a good team player under tight deadline constraints is key to success.
Matching at Ads is a critical component of our Ads funnel and responsible for ensuring that we are retrieving relevant and engaging Ads for our users. We are building the next generation of our retrieval systems to sustain the growth of the business for the future. We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer that will develop the algorithms for our retrieval system.
In this role you will drive step-change improvements in our outcomes, impact our platform revenue and quality of our ads, and formulate approaches to greenfield product opportunities. You will own end-to-end the ideation, development, testing and productization of these algorithms. You will work with complex problems in the ads retrieval space, provide solution that adhere to Apple’s privacy principles, review and contribute to state of the art in research, work with a variety of cross functional teams to ensure the feasibility and robustness of delivering new capabilities. This role will work closely with organizational partners and be expected to present findings across the organization.
Minimum qualifications: 4+ years of experience building machine learning capabilities across many different product areas at scale.
Proven experience in NLP, information retrieval and search.
Ability to apply and implement research concepts, ultimately in production quality code.
Experience defining clear, testable research hypotheses, including intended impact on the business.
Deep understanding of design of experiments, online experimentation approaches, preferably at scale.
Experience contributing and/or reviewing research for top conferences and publications.
Master's, or equivalent experience, in NLP, Machine Learning, Statistics, Forecasting, Optimization, Reinforcement Learning or related field with experience building production systems or have equivalent experience working with large data science / machine learning projects in industry.
Preferred qualifications: PhD, or equivalent experience, in NLP, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Large Language Model, Reinforcement Learning or related field with experience building production systems or have equivalent experience working with large data science / machine learning projects in industry.

title: Senior Manager, Support Experience Readiness
description:

This organization makes sure AppleCare’s global contact centers deliver world-class support on day one of new product introductions across Hardware, Platforms, and Services. You will set readiness strategy, prioritize across multiple roadmaps, and report progress to senior leadership. Experience managing large, cross-functional programs in support environments, preferably with an emphasis on technology solutions
Excellent communication skills, adapting fluidly to any audience: presenting to executive leadership one day and hosting a roundtable with customer support advisors the next
Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships across cross-functional teams
Strong analytical skills, using qualitative and quantitative analysis to measure program success before and after launch
Proficient knowledge of the system development life cycle
Ability to travel several times a year, domestically and internationally
Preferred qualifications: Knowledge of the AppleCare Contact Center tools and processes
Knowledge of Apple Support customer experiences
Deep technical expertise in Apple products and services
Experience in customer support, with a passion for building technology-enabled experiences for customers and innovative solutions for a worldwide Advisor population
Collaborative and open to debate, and willing to challenge ideas to reach the best outcome for the team and the customer
Experience with launch or new product introduction readiness

title: Senior Product Manager, Forecast & Supply Automation and Analytics
description:
Apple runs one of the most complex and efficient supply chains in the world. It is powered by internal systems and tools built and managed by the GSSM Solutions & Strategy team. These tools help us manage cost and supply, and they put supply chain intelligence at the center of our decisions.
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who understands the supply chain and can build software products that automate it. You will own tools for forecast and supply automation and analysis. You will take a complex forecast or supply problem, design the right solution, and partner with engineering to ship it. You will also present the story behind it to executives.
GSSM enables the mass production of Apple's entire product line, including iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro. The applications we build are used every day by Global Supply Managers, Material Program Managers, Suppliers, and Contract Manufacturers. They manage supply, cost, and BOM across all products and regions.
In this role, you will:
Product strategy and solution design:
• Own the product vision and roadmap. Define the strategy for forecast and supply automation and analysis tools. Prioritize work based on user pain points and business impact.
• Turn ambiguous problems into products. Take a complex forecast or supply problem, determine the right solution, and design an intuitive workflow and UI.
• Automate forecast logic. Define how forecast is calculated and translated across supply chain nodes, from finished goods through modules and components to raw materials. Work with engineering to build that logic into scalable, automated tools.
• Expose the levers. Identify the levers that influence forecast output. Build them into the product so users can model changes and see downstream impact.
• Build allocation tools. Define allocation approaches that maximize usable supply, and partner with engineering to turn them into optimization logic and user workflows.
• Build supply analytics. Deliver demand vs. supply and weeks-of-stock tools that quantify how excess or short supply affects FATP, Module CTB, and their inputs.
• Put BOM intelligence to work. Use your understanding of the BOM and the technical features of components to shape data models, reporting, and segmentation in the product.
Development and delivery:
• Translate business needs into technical requirements. Convert business requirements into clear technical requirements, user stories, and workflows that data engineering and software engineering can build against.
• Partner through development. Work with data and software engineers throughout the build. Contribute to UI design and workflow decisions, and define performance expectations. Run UAT and testing with end users.
• Lead implementation and rollout. Plan and execute launch, training, and adoption of new tools and features across user groups.
• Close the feedback loop. Gather user feedback and turn it into prioritized input for engineering to shape design. Manage production support and issue triage.
• Partner closely with users. Work daily with cross-functional teams to understand on-the-ground pain points and improve tools iteratively.
• Tell the story. Present product strategy, progress, tradeoffs, and results to executive leadership.
Minimum qualifications: Bachelors degree
7+ years of experience in product management, technical program management, or internal tools development, with strong supply chain domain expertise (supply, demand, or material planning) in hardware or consumer electronics
Strong working knowledge of BOM structures and supply chain flows, and the ability to turn them into data models, calculation logic, and product requirements
Hands-on understanding of how component and raw material forecasts are derived from finished goods demand, and experience working with engineering to automate that logic across supply chain nodes
Working knowledge of SQL, Python, or similar tools
Experience turning demand vs. supply, weeks-of-stock, and FATP and Module CTB impact analyses into tools, dashboards, and automated workflows
Experience translating business requirements into technical requirements and user stories that data engineering and software engineering teams can build against
Experience partnering with engineers and designers across the development lifecycle, including UI and workflow design, performance requirements, and UAT and testing with end users
Experience leading implementation, rollout, and adoption of software products, and managing production support
Ability to take an ambiguous forecast or supply problem from concept to a shipped product with an intuitive workflow and UI
Excellent written and verbal communication, with experience presenting product strategy and results to senior leadership
Preferred qualifications: Experience building allocation optimization or other constraint-based logic into software tools
Ability to interpret technical component specifications and incorporate them into data models, reporting, and product features
Experience gathering user feedback and turning it into prioritized product improvements
Track record of shipping internal tools, dashboards, or automation that users found intuitive
Familiarity with data pipelines, APIs, and data modeling
Familiarity with AI-assisted or agentic workflows for analysis and automation
Experience working directly with supply managers, material program managers, or contract manufacturers

title: Senior Security Engineer - Strategic Risk
description:
The Apple Services Engineering Security team builds and provides secure systems and infrastructure that fuel Apple’s services (such as iCloud, iTunes, Siri, App Store, and Maps). As part of the ASE Security team, you will help manage the security needs of Apple’s services around the world. You will build and integrate the security controls, guardrails, and frameworks that help protect our customers data in Apple’s infrastructure. Your work will help build solutions to a variety of outstanding security risks to Apple systems and data. Join us, and you’ll play a meaningful role in ensuring the highest standard of security for one of the most-watched companies in the world.
In this role, you will be the primary security team point of contact for several large engineering efforts. You will work with engineering teams throughout their development lifecycle. You will conduct security reviews, post incident reviews, develop threat models, and use the insights from these engagements to build scalable methodologies. You will help define, automate and advocate for application level and platform-wide security improvements with a focus on risks to customer accounts and data. You will play a hands on role in ensuring that programs are reviewed, adjusted, implemented and tested appropriately.
Minimum qualifications: 7 or more years conducting security reviews, incident response, threat modeling, or security engineering
Demonstrated ability to design, document, and implement new security processes
Understanding of cloud-native architecture and managed platform service (eg. compute, storage, networking, databases)
Expertise in threat modeling, operational threat intelligence, and common attack vectors and frameworks.
Understanding of applied cryptography, access control, modern authentication frameworks, and other security mechanisms
Experience with enterprise log collection and analysis platforms (e.g., Splunk, OSQuery)
Preferred qualifications: Experience with threat hunting, insider risk and/or investigations
Experience working with data engineers to define metrics and interpret results from detection and risk models
Experience in applying and experimenting with AI/ML, to solve security related use-cases

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure Services
description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization.
IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.”
Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.

From individual facilities to a worldwide network, Infrastructure Services ensures the technology underneath everything works without question.
We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) with deep expertise in cloud infrastructure, production Kubernetes, and platform resilience, combined with a forward-looking mindset in AI-driven automation. In this role, you will partner closely with engineering leadership and cross-functional teams to scale and modernize our cloud platform, elevate operational excellence, and embed intelligent automation across reliability and operations workflows.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role for a senior engineer with extensive SRE or DevOps experience who can architect resilient distributed systems, build production-grade tooling, and influence long-term platform strategy.

Deep production Kubernetes expertise, with hands-on experience architecting, securing, and maintaining large-scale clusters.
Extensive AWS experience, with in-depth knowledge of core AWS networking, compute, security, and storage primitives (Azure or GCP experience also valued).
Strong software engineering capability with proficiency in Golang or Java for developing automation services, operators, and backend tooling.
Demonstrated experience defining SLOs and SLIs, as well as instrumenting full-stack observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry.
Solid grounding in distributed systems, microservices architectures, networking protocols, high availability, and disaster recovery.
Proven track record in leading production incident response, conducting root-cause investigations, and driving preventative fixes.
Hands-on experience designing and operating automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using modern tooling such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or ArgoCD.
Preferred qualifications: 10+ years of progressive experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or Platform Engineering roles supporting mission-critical distributed systems.
Hands-on experience applying AI/ML or LLM-based tooling to SRE workflows, anomaly detection, or runbook automation.
Familiarity with orchestration and agentic frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph.
Practical experience authoring and maintaining custom Kubernetes Operators and Controllers using Kubebuilder or Operator SDK.
Background in building Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) and self-service cloud infrastructure.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Development Engineering Workflows, Core OS
description:
The Development Engineering Workflows team builds the systems that power how operating systems are developed at Apple. Core OS creates the software foundation for every Apple product, ensuring tight integration between hardware and software to provide a platform for magical user experiences. You will design and build the agentic systems and services that Core OS engineers rely on to develop, test, and ship the software behind every Apple product. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of developer tooling and applied AI. If you want to understand how Apple's operating systems get built and reimagine how that work happens, this is that opportunity.
You will own the design and delivery of agentic workflows, backend services, and a developer platform that transforms how Core OS develops software. You will work directly with Core OS teams to identify workflow opportunities, build APIs and tools that agents act through, and operate services that keep everything fast and reliable. Because your tools are your products, you get to draw on your own experience as a developer to shape everything you build.

1+ year of hands-on experience building agentic workflows or systems powered by large language models (LLMs).
Experience designing and building backend services and APIs.
Working knowledge of distributed systems fundamentals.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a passion for developer tooling and product quality.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience

Experience with evaluation frameworks for agent quality, including benchmarks, regression tests, and confidence scoring.
Experience building developer tooling, continuous integration systems, or build systems.

Prior development in Unix, Linux, or macOS.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Payments
description:
What if the payment infrastructure you built tomorrow processed millions of transactions by next quarter, across every Apple Store, the App Store, and an expanding universe of fintech partners worldwide? The Payments Engineering team sits at the core of Apple's Wallet, Payments, and Commerce organization, owning the foundational rails that make every transaction possible and pioneering capabilities like Tap to Pay on iPhone that redefine what a payment terminal can be. You will own meaningful slices of distributed systems that must stay available and performant under transaction volumes few engineers ever encounter, working alongside privacy and security teams to ensure correctness is never an afterthought. Each week brings a mix of deep design conversations, hands-on Java development, and cross-functional problem solving with quality, testing, and partner engineering teams whose success is inseparable from yours. • Proven experience building high-availability, high-throughput distributed systems that operate reliably at significant transaction volumes.
Hands-on proficiency in Java or a JVM-based language (Kotlin, Scala) with production-grade code shipped and maintained.
Deep understanding of concurrent and asynchronous processing patterns, applied to real-world backend systems.
Track record of engaging across the full software development lifecycle, including design, testing, deployment, and on-call ownership.
Demonstrated ability to communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to cross-functional partners across engineering, privacy, and security.

Shipped features backed by both relational and non-relational data stores, with informed choices about consistency and query performance tradeoffs.
Hands-on experience with message queue systems (Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ) in high-throughput, event-driven architectures.
Deployed and operated services on a major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including infrastructure-as-code and observability tooling.
Prior work in fintech, payments, or commerce, with direct exposure to transaction integrity, reconciliation, or regulatory compliance challenges.

title: Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst, SEAR
description:
Apple’s Security Engineering & Architecture (SEAR) team builds the core operating system security that underpins every Apple product, including Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and more.
To keep our users safe, we’re looking for an exceptional senior threat intelligence analyst to join our group of security researchers and threat intelligence analysts. Protecting more than a billion devices. Turning security research and threat intelligence into engineering decisions that shape every layer of the stack. Collaborating with some of the most creative, dedicated, and driven engineers in the industry. Impeccable attention to detail.

Growth mindset, thrives in fast-paced, changing environments.
Excellent communications skills (verbal and written).

title: Senior iOS & macOS UI Engineer, Settings
description:
Apple devices have revolutionized how people live, connect, and work. By thoughtfully blending intuitive, innovative system software with beautiful hardware, we design and build a uniquely delightful user experience. As the System Experience team, we lead the charge in building this experience.

Technical excellence – you design clear, maintainable abstractions with well-considered failure modes and write robust, performant, unit-tested code
Critical thinking with influence — you evaluate the tradeoffs associated with each potential solution, make an informed decision, and communicate clearly to influence others

Teamwork — you understand that the best products aren’t made by one engineer working alone; the better we collaborate, the better the result
Bachelor of Computer Science or equivalent skills and work experience
Preferred qualifications: Bachelors of Masters of Computer Science is preferred

title: Sensor MEMS Design Manager - Custom Silicon Management
description:
Are you a leader? Do you want to utilize your engineering background to make big things happen? Can you influence, connect, get results and communicate effectively? title: Silicon Debug Engineer
description:
Do you have a passion for solving the hardest problems in silicon? Do you thrive at the intersection of circuit theory, device physics, and hands-on failure investigation? As part of our Silicon Debug group, you'll take complex, often elusive silicon failures and systematically uncover their root cause — from electrical characterization all the way down to physical analysis. Imagine yourself at the center of our SoC bring-up and product ramp effort, collaborating across circuit design, process engineering, DFT, and failure analysis teams — with a critical impact on getting functional products to millions of customers quickly.
Minimum qualifications: A minimum of a bachelor's degree in relevant field and a minimum of 10 years of relevant industry experience.
Preferred qualifications: Experience in one or more of the following areas: SRAM circuits, custom circuit design, silicon debug.
Experience in design or debug of low-voltage / low-power custom circuits.
Deep understanding of deep-submicron device physics, leakage mechanisms, and technology interactions with device behavior.
Solid understanding of device matching, device noise sources (1/f, thermal), extrinsic noise sources (supply noise, jitter), and their impact on high-precision circuits.
Familiarity with electrical failure analysis (eFA) techniques and physical failure analysis (pFA) workflows, and the ability to plan FA strategies based on electrical debug data.
Understanding of Dynamic Lock-in Thermography (DLS) and Lock-in Thermography (LIT) for localization of resistive and leakage defects, including their sensitivity limits and how thermal signatures correlate to specific circuit fault modes.
Knowledge of Nanoprobe techniques for electrical probing of deep-submicron nodes, and appreciation of how probe contact, voltage bias, and electron beam exposure can perturb sensitive analog or memory circuits.
Awareness of how physical sample preparation steps (deprocessing, FIB cross-section, delayering) can alter or destroy evidence of electrical failures, and how to coordinate FA plans that preserve failure signatures.
Ability to interpret FA results (photon emission maps, OBIRCH, thermal maps, TEM/SEM imagery) in the context of circuit topology and failure electrical signatures.
Ability to conduct structured experiments during silicon debug, gather and analyze large datasets, and utilize scripting to support efficient handling of debug data.
Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, Perl, or others) and CAD automation tools.
Knowledge of industry-standard circuit design and simulation tools.

title: Sr Software Engineer - LLM Evaluation and Test Infrastructure
description:
Do you believe generative models can transform smart assistants and creative workflows used by billions? Do you believe it can fundamentally shift how people interact with devices and communicate? We truly believe it can! We are looking for highly skilled senior software engineers experienced in architecting and deploying test and validation infrastructure for consumer-facing products using large-scale client/server ML systems.
You will play a critical role in designing and building LLMs online and offline validation infrastructure, tools, frameworks, and methodologies that enable product teams across Apple to develop state-of-the-art generative AI solutions that power amazingly intelligent user experiences on iPhone, Mac, Watch, iPad, and more. We are the Intelligence System Experience (ISE) team within Apple’s software organization. The team works at the intersection between multimodal machine learning and system experiences. System Experience (Springboard, Settings), Keyboards, Pencil & Paper, Shortcuts are some of the experiences that the team oversees. These experiences that our users enjoy are backed by production scale ML workflows. Visual Understanding of People, Text, Handwriting & Scenes, multilingual NLP for writing workflows & knowledge extraction, behavioral modeling for proactive suggestions, and privacy preserving learning are areas our multi disciplinary ML teams focus on.
This role is responsible for defining and developing generative AI systems validation infrastructure by collaborating with diverse cross-functional partners, including machine learning engineers, data scientists, software developers, and product managers. The evaluation infrastructure includes adopting or building new client and server CI pipelines and developing scalable automation tools and frameworks across all Apple platforms. The evaluation infrastructure should allow cross-functional teams to conduct rigorous testing to ensure the accuracy, performance, reliability, and stability of ISE’s future generative AI models across various products and use cases. This role will also work closely with product and program teams to ensure validation infrastructure development is done in lockstep with the new features and products roadmap and to drive a high adoption among product and ML engineers. This is a fast-paced role with high visibility, impact, and influence in building one of the industry’s most advanced generative AI systems.
Minimum qualifications: BS/MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning or related field
6+ years of proven expertise in software development with Java, Python, Swift, or Objective-C
Preferred qualifications: Strong software engineering skills to create a scalable and robust infrastructure for generative AI systems training and inference pipelines leveraging on-device and server-side ML models.
Fundamental knowledge of ML concepts and understanding of ML-based product lifecycle and operations
Familiarity with ML toolkits such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, SkLearn, etc.
Hands-on experience in building an automation infrastructure, tools, and frameworks for large-scale AI/ML or cloud- based applications leveraging cross-functional partnerships
Demonstrated experience in evaluating and testing machine learning models. Familiarity with performance metrics, validation techniques, and statistical analysis.
A passion for staying up-to-date with the latest advancements in generative AI models and their applications. Ability to quickly learn new technologies, adapt to evolving project requirements, and think creatively to solve complex challenges.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively collaborate with multidisciplinary teams. Ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

description:

title: Supply Demand Planner, Infrastructure Services
description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.
Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.
Infrastructure Services is part of IS&T and the foundation of Apple's global network operations — managing data center equipment and systems to deliver compute, storage, and networking services for teams across Apple, including its internal developer community. From individual facilities to a worldwide network, Infrastructure Services ensures the technology underneath everything works without question.
We are seeking a highly motivated Supply Planner who will be responsible for end-to-end supply planning of data center and facilities materials. You will build supply plans that meet Apple's build schedules, sync demand across Engineering, Site Services, and Integration Centers, and partner with the teams managing long-lead suppliers. You'll work daily in SAP and Supply Chain Collaboration (SCC), and grow into a subject matter expert supporting the broader team.
Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or equivalent experience.
5+ years in supply planning, inventory management, or materials management.
Hands-on experience with SAP MRP (including transactions, troubleshooting, and SCC) or an equivalent ERP in a production planning environment
Experience planning long-lead capital equipment or complex hardware BOMs, such as data center power/cooling infrastructure, server racks, or networking equipment.
Advanced proficiency with Excel or Numbers, including manipulating large datasets (e.g., pivot tables, complex formulas, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP) to drive supply chain analysis and reporting
Preferred qualifications: Direct experience planning data center infrastructure, facilities materials, or storage hardware (JBODs, HDDs, controllers) for hyperscale environments.

Experience building AI-based tools (e.g., LLM-assisted scripts in Python, internal automations) to streamline planning work, and partnering with Reporting teams on Tableau or Business Objects dashboards.
Strong written and visual communication — able to drive executive decisions with concise, data-backed updates and clear briefing materials.

title: Wireless Intelligence Software Engineer, Wireless Technologies & Ecosystems
description:
Are you excited by the idea of wireless devices that can sense, learn and adapt on their own? Do you enjoy problems where real-time embedded systems meet machine learning? In the Wireless Technologies and Ecosystems (WTE) organization, you'll help bring smart, reliable connectivity to the world through cellular, satellite and Wi-Fi. Our team builds the intelligence behind that connectivity: the scheduling control software that runs on various Apple products, and ML-driven schedulers and models that power wireless intelligence features. You'll design, develop and deliver the next generation of these technologies so that connections stay fast, robust and power-efficient.
Join WTE and be part of a world-class team of engineers working with cross-functional partners to drive innovation in products used by millions of people worldwide. We are looking for talented, highly motivated, self-directed engineers who can work across layers, from embedded scheduling and control software to the ML models that guide it. Our work starts on Apple Watch and extends to iPhone, iPad, Mac and other wireless products, solving everyday connectivity problems at scale. You'll take ideas from research and prototype through to shipping features, and your work will directly shape how Apple products connect.
We are looking for a highly motivated software engineer to join an exceptional development team building wireless intelligence for Apple's next-generation products. In this role, you will develop wireless software solutions used across Apple’s wireless products, combining embedded software development with applied artificial intelligence and machine learning. Your work will include designing ML-driven smart scheduling algorithms for 5G/6G, satellite and Wi-Fi, and integrating them into real-time, resource-constrained embedded systems. You'll take ownership of features end to end, from prototyping and evaluation through production integration, validation and field performance analysis. The role needs exceptional problem-solving and communication skills, strong programming ability, careful attention to detail and a passion for building great products. This position demands exceptional problem-solving and communication abilities, robust programming proficiency, a meticulous attention to detail, and a passionate commitment to creating superior products. You will do well in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, and your contributions will make a clear difference to future Apple products.
Minimum qualifications: MSc in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.
Strong foundation in wireless communication systems, such as 5G NR/LTE, Wi-Fi (802.11) or satellite communications.
Hands-on experience developing and applying machine learning models to engineering problems.
Proficiency in C/C++ and Python.
Experience using AI coding tools as part of your regular workflow, with the ability to critically review, verify and debug AI-generated code.
Preferred qualifications: PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.
Experience with embedded or real-time software development on resource-constrained devices.
Knowledge of MAC/PHY scheduling, radio resource management, or multi-radio coexistence.
Experience deploying ML models on-device, model quantization and optimization.
Experience analyzing wireless logs and over-the-air performance data.
Track record of taking research concepts or prototypes through to product-quality implementations.
Ability to communicate complex technical work clearly to cross-functional partners and senior engineers.
Comfortable navigating ambiguity and adapting quickly as priorities change.

Road test vehicles to identify issues, verify repairs and ensure they are operating safely and properly.

description:
Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership.
